filters.label: Date Preset
filters.options:
None
Past Week
Past Two Weeks
Past Month
All

name: Report for molvi
query:
SELECT 
    status,
    registration_date,
    student_name
FROM 
    `tabStudent Registration`
WHERE 
    (
        -- Handle Date Preset for filtering registration date
        CASE
            WHEN %(date_preset)s = 'Past Week' THEN registration_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
            WHEN %(date_preset)s = 'Past Two Weeks' THEN registration_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 14 DAY)
            ELSE 1 = 1 -- No filtering if no preset selected
        END
    )
    AND (
        -- Ensure only one checkbox filter is applied at a time
        (%(graduated)s = 1 AND status = 'Graduated') OR
        (%(in_batch)s = 1 AND status = 'In Batch') OR
        (%(waiting)s = 1 AND status = 'Waiting')
    )
